ref: verifier agent prompt, Output Summary (verifier_report.json in <results_dir>)
what: The raw eval.verify_supported report for a 1976-cell suite is 1.6 MB; the repo pre-commit check-large-files hook rejects >500 KB, so the mandated artifact cannot be committed as emitted. Required a hand-compacted report and a re-commit.
suggest: Add a --compact flag to eval.verify_supported (summary + loud categories in full, bulk categories as counts), or state that results_dir stays outside git.

ref: verifier agent prompt, Drift Handling / supported_fail table
what: Drift detection relies on XPASS, but validate() refuses every cell outside SUPPORTED, so a kernel that already implements a TARGET value (here stride, dilation, bf8_b weights: 52 cells) is invisible to the CLI. Only a manual gate-lift probe found it.
suggest: Add a step: for TARGET values whose code path already exists (CT args, dtype-derived CB formats), lift the gate on that golden slice (select ids by axes from test_axes.json; pytest -k cannot express axis=value) and promote what passes review.

ref: verifier agent prompt, Native kernel support policy (partial-tick wrapper escape hatch)
what: The policy offers a ttnn.to_layout/to_memory_config wrapper as a [~] fallback, which contradicts the run-level one-native-dispatch mandate; the queue text had to override it explicitly.
suggest: Make the wrapper escape hatch conditional on the run not imposing a single-dispatch rule, or drop it when that rule is present.
